_note: Register: krama for every sentence, bare stems on buttons (Èkspor, Simpen, Batal, Tutup), matching the pack's own level -- the studio addresses one reader and a Javanese interface that addressed them in ngoko would be the same discourtesy a ngoko card is. Terms of art: a printed face is sisi and a sheet is lembar, so "4 faces / 2 sheets" is "4 sisi / 2 lembar"; duplex is bolak-balik; typeface is jinis aksara; romanisation is romanisasi; the respelling field is Cara maos and the literal gloss Teges harfiah; "glossed into" is Teges ing basa. The divider is pamisah and "garis" is kept for the printed hairline (warn.hairline-too-thin), which is ink where the divider is not. Interpolation: Intl.DisplayNames hands Javanese the bare ethnonym ("Inggris", "Jepang", "Jawa"), which is a country or a people on its own, so every template that takes {language} carries the head noun basa in front of it -- "Ing basa {language}", "Basa {language} dipunginakaken ing {regions}", "kertu basa {language}", "panduan basa {language}". This is the same repair the Indonesian catalogue records, and it is needed here for the same reason and on the same six templates. Romanisation systems keep their Latin names -- Javanese has no settled form for Hepburn, Kunrei-shiki, McCune-Reischauer or Hunterian, and ALA-LC, BGN/PCGN, IAST and RTGS are standards initialisms -- except roman.rr, which is calqued as "Romanisasi Révisi". Orthography follows the pack: é = [e], è = [ɛ], bare e = [ə]. Message-screen keys (display.*): display.roman says "miturut éjaan basa Jawi", after field.title.respell -- the line shown is the say column (the respelling in the reader's own orthography, core/respell.js), not the romanisation; display.turn drops "sideways" the way board.turn already does. Added 13 keys: drill.reveal, format.headSlot.logo, gallery.signal, board.rate and signal.* (the Morse-signal page). "Sandi Morse" follows the title of the Javanese Wikipedia article Sandi morse. "Kacepetan" reuses the word already established in display.speak; signal.lede follows the passive, subject-avoiding phrasing personal.lede already uses rather than a direct second-person imperative.

editor.noTranslation: Aplikasi menika mboten nerjemahaken. Basa sanèsipun kedah dipuntèmpèl utawi dipunketik piyambak — mboten wonten ingkang dipunkintunaken dhateng pundi-pundi.

speaker.title: Caranipun panjenengan ngendika
speaker.lede: Sawetawis basa ngéwahi ukara miturut sinten ingkang ngendika. Kawangsulan sapisan ing ngriki, lajeng saben ukara badhé mawi swanten panjenengan piyambak — ing papan pacelathon, ing kertu, lan ing latihan kuis. Mboten wonten ingkang dipunkinten-kinten, lan mboten wonten ingkang medal saking pirantos menika.
speaker.unspecified: Mboten kersa ngendika — ngangge tembung ingkang limrah
speaker.nothingToAsk: Kalih basa menika mboten ngéwahi ukara miturut sinten ingkang ngendika, dados mboten wonten ingkang kedah dipunatur.
speaker.unset: {axes}: dèrèng dipunatur, dados ukara menika ngangge tembung ingkang limrah.
speaker.speaker_gender.why: Ing basa-basa menika, tembung kriya utawi tembung sipat bab dhiri panjenengan piyambak éwah wujudipun. “Kula kesasar” lan “matur nuwun” dados ukara ingkang bèda miturut wangsulanipun.

speech.remote-only: Swanten kanggé basa menika namung setunggal, lan mbetahaken sambungan jaringan.

speech.unsupported: Panjlajah wèb menika mboten saged maosaken tulisan.
speech.unmapped: Mboten wonten swanten kanggé basa menika ing pundi kémawon.
speech.synthesis-failed: Swantenipun mandheg. Nyuwun dipuncoba malih, utawi tulisanipun dipuntedahaken.

personal.lede: Sedaya ingkang wonten ing ngriki namung manggèn ing pirantos menika lan mboten wonten papan sanès. Salinan dipunsimpen supados saged dipunpindhah dhateng tilpun sanès, utawi kanggé cadhangan.
personal.confirm: Saben ukara ingkang panjenengan serat, setèlan panjenengan, lan éwahan kertu ingkang kasimpen badhé dipunbusak? Menika mboten saged dipunwangsulaken, lan namung salinan ingkang kasimpen dalanipun wangsul.

signal.lede: Menapa ingkang badhé dipunwedharaken, kaserat wonten mriki. Telepon badhé ngedhap-edhapaken wontenipun ing Sandi Morse — wonten skrin saha lampu kamera — kanthi kacepetan ingkang saged dipunwaos ing tiyang. SOS cekap satunggal pencetan kémawon.
